# Liquid Textile (vendored)

The foundation layer of [Liquid Textile](https://github.com/nathanswavely/liquid-textile),
copied in so SlopChop keeps zero runtime dependencies and its review page works offline.
MIT licensed; see LICENSE.

- Version: 0.3.0 (unreleased), commit 103a440 on foundation-patchwork-audit
  (nathanswavely/liquid-textile#1). What changed since 0.2.0 is in that
  repo's CHANGELOG.md.
- Files: foundation.css, base.css, behaviors.js

Do not edit these copies. Change Liquid Textile, then copy the files across again.
